04996f60d3.q: What is the PACE accountability framework in Better Body Academy coaching?
04996f60d3.a: PACE is an acronym that breaks accountability into four specific components: P is for posting into the group, A is for attending coaching calls, C is for checking in with weekly and daily check-ins, and E is for engaging with your coaches. Every single long-term winner in the program does all four of these things, and clients typically stop doing these before their results start to slump.

5f221092fc.q: What is the gym membership versus training partner analogy for accountability?
5f221092fc.a: A gym membership gives you access to everything you need—equipment, spaces, weights, classes—yet most people pay for it and barely go. A training partner who texts you at six o'clock in the morning and waits in their car creates accountability through expectation. The only difference is that someone is expecting you, which is what accountability means and why people actually show up.
